system.description: You were bound to the Tremere Council of Seven more tightly than most, whether from a suspicious regent, a past misstep, or a missive from on high. You must spend a Willpower Trait to take any action that violates Tremere policy or defies the command of any Tremere who outranks you. Escaping this bond — through the Vaulderie, another blood bond, or the ritual Abandon the Fetters — marks you for destruction if the wrong people find out.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
